content: i18next/react-i18next is the largest-ecosystem, most battle-tested React i18n solution and is what most teams default to for pragmatic FR/EN dashboards; its non-ICU key format is a minor tradeoff outweighed by the tooling maturity (lazy namespace loading, backend plugins, pluralization, interpolation). react-intl (ICU-strict) and Lingui (extraction-macro, smallest bundle) are viable alternatives but add friction not justified for a 2-locale B2B dashboard.
